+from rich.text import Text
+from rich.console import Console
+
+def test_expand_tabs_styles():
+    console = Console(width=80)
+    # Create Text with a tab that has a specific style
+    text = Text("Hello\tWorld")
+    text.stylize("red", start=5, end=6)  # Style the tab character
+    
+    # Expand tabs
+    text.expand_tabs(tab_size=8)
+    
+    # "Hello" is 5 chars (0,1,2,3,4). Tab is at index 5.
+    # Tab expands to spaces to reach next multiple of 8.
+    # 8 - 5 = 3 spaces. Indices 5, 6, 7.
+    # Total length: 5 + 3 + 5 = 13.
+    
+    print(f"Plain text: {repr(text.plain)}")
+    print(f"Spans: {text._spans}")
+    
+    # Check each index of the expanded tab
+    for i in range(5, 8):
+        style = text.get_style_at_offset(console, i)
+        print(f"Index {i}: style={style}")
+        assert str(style) == "red", f"Expected red style at index {i}, but got {style}"
+        
+    print("Test passed!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_expand_tabs_styles()
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}")
+        exit(1)
